hints.title: Invoice Customer Contact Metrics
hints.text: For each invoice, report invoice_id, customer_name, price, total contacts, and trusted contacts who are also customers.

hints.title: Left Join Contacts and Customers
hints.text: left join Invoices with Customers, Contacts, and again Customers on contact email to identify trusted contacts.

hints.title: Trusted Contacts Aggregation Blueprint
hints.text: select inv.invoice_id, c.customer_name, inv.price, count(con.user_id) as contacts_cnt, count(cust_con.customer_id) as trusted_contacts_cnt from Invoices inv join Customers c on inv.user_id = c.customer_id left join Contacts con on inv.user_id = con.user_id left join Customers cust_con on con.contact_email = cust_con.email group by inv.invoice_id, c.customer_name, inv.price order by inv.invoice_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT inv.invoice_id, 
       c.customer_name, 
       inv.price, 
       COUNT(con.user_id) AS contacts_cnt, 
       COUNT(cust_con.customer_id) AS trusted_contacts_cnt
FROM Invoices inv
JOIN Customers c ON inv.user_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN Contacts con ON inv.user_id = con.user_id
LEFT JOIN Customers cust_con ON con.contact_email = cust_con.email
GROUP BY inv.invoice_id, c.customer_name, inv.price
ORDER BY inv.invoice_id;
```

complexity.notes: Equi-joins and group aggregation order invoice summaries in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner joining contacts drops invoices for customers with zero contacts recorded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual left join on customer email counts contacts and trusted contacts in one pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of LEFT JOIN to preserve invoices with zero contacts and COUNT on matched customer_id.

import pandas as pd

def count_visited_nodes(customers: pd.DataFrame, contacts: pd.DataFrame, invoices: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cust_emails = set(customers['email'])
    res = []
    cust_map = dict(zip(customers['customer_id'], customers['customer_name']))
    for _, inv in invoices.iterrows():
        uid = inv['user_id']
        c_name = cust_map.get(uid, '')
        user_contacts = contacts[contacts['user_id'] == uid]
        contacts_cnt = len(user_contacts)
        trusted_cnt = user_contacts['contact_email'].isin(cust_emails).sum()
        res.append({
            'invoice_id': inv['invoice_id'],
            'customer_name': c_name,
            'price': inv['price'],
            'contacts_cnt': contacts_cnt,
            'trusted_contacts_cnt': trusted_cnt
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(res)
    return df.sort_values(by='invoice_id') if not df.empty else df
solutions.approach: Pandas Iterative Invoice Summary with Email Set Lookup
